notes: Good evening. Tonight is about one thing: China's annual reconciliation for individual income tax. If you have worked here for a couple of years, your phone has probably nudged you every March. Some people tap through and get a few hundred yuan back, some are told they owe a little, and some never open it. By the end of tonight you should be able to tell whether you need to file, work out roughly whether you get money back or owe some, and finish it in the IIT app yourself. The people and figures in tonight's examples are made up. The rules are real, and each page cites its source. This is general teaching, not personal tax advice. The IIT app and your tax office have the final word.
